{{Quote|It's food and medical supplies from the Republic!|This Twi'lek|<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref>}}
This '''Twi'lek''' was part of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]] and participated in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managed to send supplies to the people of Ryloth inside [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], this Twi'lek was one of the first who opened one of the pods and retrieve the supplies inside.<ref name="Supply Lines" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Created for [[Supply Lines]], the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', this Twi'lek was voiced by [[Brian George]] and is listed as "male Twi'lek" in the episode's credits.<ref name="Supply Lines" />
